title: Asymmetric Synthesis
description: Molecules come in mirror-image pairs, and living things use only one of each. A handed catalyst makes one and not the other. Unlocks the Asymmetric Reactor and the Chiral Ligand.

puzzle.goal: A catalyst lowers the barrier to one mirror image of a product by an energy E more than to the other, at temperature T. Write how many times faster the favoured one forms, s, with the gas constant R.
puzzle.name: Selectivity
puzzle.ask: Find s for E = @{E} J/mol, R = 8.314 and T = @{T} K.
puzzle.method: Each rate goes as e^(−barrier/RT) (Arrhenius, with the same prefactor): their ratio is e^(E/RT).
